name: Chikan Play Densha no Naka de ○○ ya ×× na Koto
original_name: 痴漢プレイ 電車の中で○○や××なこと
source:
Toru has a girlfriend, Yuu. They keep good relationship and often have sex. But one day, when they are on the crowded train, their sexual desire suddenly explodes and they start having sex.... "It's great! More comfortable than normal sex...." They are gradually addicted to it.... Also, Yuzu, Toru's friend, and Sakura, Yuu's friend, get involved in it and a circle of train sex widens....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081023212323/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011642]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
阿彻与女友小优感情融洽，平日里也时常偷尝云雨之欢。然而某一天，挤在沙丁鱼罐头般的早高峰电车上时，两人压抑不住骤然喷薄的欲火，竟在车厢里当众交合起来……
“太刺激了！比平时做还要舒服……”
食髓知味的两人渐渐对这种背德快感欲罢不能……不久之后，阿彻的好友柚子与小优的闺蜜小樱也被卷入其中，“电车性爱”的圈子自此愈发扩大……
